questions.question: How many categories should the monthly email keep?

rewriteBeforeAnswers: The monthly email lists every category, and people stop reading halfway through it. Cut the list down so the email is short enough to read to the end, and finish when it lists only the reduced set of categories.
final: The monthly email lists every category, and people stop reading halfway through it. Cut the list down so the email is short enough to read to the end, and finish when it lists only the reduced set of categories. Keep only the top 3 categories.
